title: Where to place CCTV cameras in a shop
description: A simple guide to CCTV camera positions for shops and small businesses in Dubai.
body: Good CCTV is about the right positions, not the number of cameras. For most shops we start with these points.
One camera above and slightly behind the counter shows the till and transactions clearly.
Place a camera at face height facing the door from inside, so every person entering is recorded clearly.
Store rooms and back doors are where losses often happen. Cover them too.
An outdoor camera covering the shop front helps with deliveries, parking and incidents at night.
Send us a photo or a quick sketch of your shop and we will suggest positions.
